call_points.text: Company expects double digit growth in FY27 backed by high double digit growth in Advanced Materials.
Planned capital allocation of ₹450-500 crore for growth-oriented capex in Garmenting and Advanced Materials.

The acquisition is funded via $60 million debt raised in India and $50 million debt at the US entity.
Dalco-GFT delivers robust financial metrics with a 17% EBITDA margin.

operating_notes.text: Arvind Atelier (FZC), incorporated in Sharjah, U.A.E. on April 20, 2026, is an 80%-held subsidiary for ready-made garments and textile trading, with 80 of 100 shares of AED 1,500 to be subscribed by Arvind.

AAML agreed to subscribe 100% of Arvind Advanced Materials US TopCo Inc., which holds 100% of Arvind Advanced Materials US HoldCo Inc., which holds 100% membership interest of Arvind Advanced Materials US BidCo LLC; all three US entities in
Dalco-GFT: CY25 revenue ~$100 Mn, ~17% EBITDA margin, ~40% ROCE, 95% cash conversion, 75 Mn lbs annual capacity across two US plants, 88% sole-source positions with 75+ customers.
AAML revenue grew at 23% CAGR FY21-FY25 to ₹1,544 Cr with EBITDA margin of 13% in FY25.
Acquisition debt: ~US$50 Mn non-recourse at the US entity and ~US$60 Mn at AAML; AAML intends to acquire the remaining ~39% from rollover shareholders in 4 years.
AAML acquired 61% of US needle-punch nonwovens maker Dalco-GFT at a $136 Mn enterprise value.
Recommended final dividend of ₹4.50 per equity share for FY26.
Varanasi greenfield garment plant built with about ₹150 Cr investment on 5.5 acres with ~65,000 sq. ft. built-up area and a stated ₹250 Cr revenue potential.
The plant is expected to employ over 1,000 people, predominantly women, and will forward-integrate Arvind's in-house knitted fabric.

timeline.summary: On 22 April 2026 Arvind reported incorporation of Arvind Atelier (FZC) in Sharjah; U.A.E.; with shares pending subscription.

On 6 May 2026 Arvind said its wholly owned subsidiary AAML had on 5 May 2026 agreed to subscribe 100% of US-based Arvind Advanced Materials US TopCo Inc., which holds a HoldCo and BidCo LLC, all incorporated 10 March 2026 with nil turnover, as internal group structuring.

On 6 May 2026 Arvind said its wholly owned subsidiary AAML acquired ~61% of US needle-punch nonwovens maker Dalco-GFT at a $136 Mn enterprise value, 7.75x CY25 EBITDA, debt-funded at Dalco and AAML levels.
On May 7, 2026, Arvind announced the completion of the merger of its US step-down subsidiary BidCo into Dalco GF Technologies LLC.
2026-05-11: Arvind published the investor call transcript regarding AAML's acquisition of a 61% stake in US-based Dalco-GFT for $136 million.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,553.09 Cr (+15.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹159.71 Cr (+5.5% YoY).
Arvind Limited’s Board, led by **Pritesh Shah**, recommended a final dividend of ₹4.50 per equity share (face value ₹10) for FY2026, pending AGM approval.
On May 15, 2026, Arvind published its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation reporting ₹2,553 Cr quarterly revenue and improved ROCE.
Arvind Limited shared the Q4 FY26 earnings conference call recording on 16th May 2026 via its website, signed by **Pritesh Shah**.
Aura Securities Private Limited, as Promoter of Arvind Limited, disclosed no new share acquisitions or encumbrances by March 2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
25 October 2026: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated Arvind's ₹150 Cr greenfield garment plant in Varanasi, with a stated ₹250 Cr revenue potential and over 1,000 jobs.
